# Cat Carousel

> A zero-JavaScript retro cat image carousel with HTML, WAP2 and WML faces.

Cat Carousel is a tiny PHP website that shows random cat (and dog, duck, bear)
images. It has no JavaScript, no login, and no build step. It serves modern
HTML, XHTML-MP for WAP2 feature phones, and WML for WAP 1.x handsets.

## Pages

- [Cat Carousel home](https://lavender.kawaiinekos.com/): random animal image carousel.
- [ARD catalog](https://lavender.kawaiinekos.com/.well-known/ard.json): machine-readable agent resource manifest.
- [Original Next.js carousel](https://github.com/reocat/cat-carousel): the project this PHP port is based on.
- [WML 1.1 DTD](http://www.wapforum.org/DTD/wml_1.1.dtd): the WAP 1.x format used by the lightest face.

## Notes for agents

- No JavaScript is required; every interaction is a plain link.
- Images are proxied, resized and cached by `img.php`; WAP1 gets 1-bit WBMP.
- The carousel state is kept in a PHP session and in query parameters.
- Crawling the home page and the image proxy is welcome.
